_notes: APV v1 (laneAPV). Replaces the soft floor bounce that SSGI gives, with SSGI OFF, using a few non-shadow point lights (no ray marching). OFF by default. Lights follow a roster fighter ('player' | 'enemy' | a roster id) or sit fixed ('fixed' + pos). Candela in HDRP physical units, exposure is fixed EV 9.4. ALL numbers are first guesses to tune by eye against the SSGI pairs in _agents/visual_qc/ssgi_out/full_vs_off. volumetricDimmer 0 keeps them out of the fog pass.
